result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021).

I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` clause with the same priority `CASE` expression the sales-rep list uses, followed by `opened_date` and `id`. I also updated the Javadoc to describe the new order. The WHERE clause is unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`RegionManagerTest` and `SupportTicketTest` pass offline. Neither test checks the order of the region list directly, so I did not verify the example ordering (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1). Nothing is committed.
